text:
Lee: quick check — onboarding 30B-arope-v2 hitting attn mismatch on sliding-window GQA runs. weights are at gs://redwood-models/30b/arope-v2/ . anyone seen this? failing on long-history requests.

Lee: failing log snippet:```
RuntimeError: attention_impl: KV size 2048 != expected 1024
 at runtime/attention.cpp:432
```

Sarah: @Lee saw something similar last week with a bad rope_scale in the model config. can you paste model_config.json (or at least rope_scale + head_kv dims)? :eyes:

Lee: model_config.json excerpt:```json
{"hidden_size": 12288, "num_attention_heads": 96, "rope_scale": 1.0, "kv_head_dim": 64, "past_kv_len": 1024 }
```

Priya: that rope_scale=1.0 looks plausible, but the runtime expects past_kv_len=1024 while sliding-window code multiplied window_size by gqa_factor elsewhere. are you running with the MQA->GQA compatibility flag? i.e. --gqa-factor=2 ?

Lee: yes passing --gqa-factor 2 in the serve config. the weights were converted with gqa folding (converter v3). converter metadata: converter_version: "3.1" and note: "folded_mqa->gqa"

Sarah: ok probable mismatch: converter folded into GQA (heads*factor) but model_config still reports original per-head dims. runtime expects per-shard KV sizes. quick mitigation: set runtime flag --accept-gqa-folded or use a compat config mapping. i can push a tiny runtime guard (check folded_head_count vs config) — will open a PR. :thumbsup:

James: other option is to create a fallback routing policy for this model that points to the quantized 8-bit variant until runtime patch merges. low risk and keeps prod traffic stable. i can add route in routing table:```yaml
- model: 30b-arope-v2
  route_on: capacity
  fallback: 30b-arope-v2-q8
```

Lee: +1 on fallback. want to avoid re-converting weights mid-weekend. can someone validate tokenizer? we had a tokenization quirk with this family (extra BOS token) that messes sliding window offsets.

Priya: i ran a quick tokenizer check: tokenizer.json shows special_tokens: {"bos_token":"", "eos_token":""} and we patch a pretokenizer that adds an extra BOS for historical compatibility. sliding-window chunker assumes no leading BOS, so we need to strip it before windowing. small patch:```diff
- chunker.take(window)
+ chunker.take(window).lstrip_bos_if_present()
```
I can attach test.

Sarah: thanks. i'll include tokenizer strip in the runtime guard PR and add an opt-in compatibility toggle (env REDWOOD_COMPAT_STRIP_BOS=true).

infra-bot: CI pipeline kicked: build/runtime-compat-guard #412 started by Sarah. logs: https://ci.redwood/run/412 :gear:

Deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 30b-arope-v2-fallback route at 2025-11-03T02:00Z (window 1h). will pause if error rate > 2% or latency regresses > 30ms.

James: i opened routing PR and added the fallback + smoke-checks. @Priya can you run the smoke with the q8 weights and the stripped-bos tokenizer? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/198

Priya: running smoke now: command i used:```bash
./scripts/smoke_test.sh --model gs://redwood-models/30b/arope-v2-q8 --prompt-file tests/sliding_window_prompts.json --strip-bos
```
Quick result: 20/20 prompts passed, no attn errors, latency +6ms median. posting full log in thread when done.

Lee: awesome — next steps: (1) merge runtime guard + tokenizer strip (Sarah) (2) merge routing fallback (James) (3) smoke + canary (Priya/infra) — if all green flip traffic to main. i'll hold off re-convert for now. thanks all. :rocket:
